comment: Cross-project eval fixture (UX-C6, UX-C7): scripts/eval_retrieval.py builds these notes into a temporary store with three bound projects. The cwd is evalcross; cases name notes as @key. Positives expect a strong portable note from a sibling project when evalcross answers weakly, or a resolved bug; forbids are notes that must never be injected.

notes.title: Cache eviction policy
notes.body: The cache uses LRU eviction with a 500 entry cap.

notes.title: Gateway routing notes
notes.body: Traffic enters through the gateway and the upload proxy, then reaches the service tier.

notes.title: Dashboard export crash
notes.body: ERR_EXPORT_77 crashed the dashboard export. Fixed by closing the file handle before the rename.

notes.title: Dashboard export rewrite
notes.body: ERR_EXPORT_77 export rewrite steps: stream rows, close handles, rename once.

notes.title: Raise the upload proxy timeout
notes.body: Dropped uploads came from a low proxy timeout. Raise the upload proxy timeout to 120 seconds.

notes.title: Rotate the signing certificate
notes.body: 1. Generate the new signing certificate. 2. Install it on the gateway. 3. Restart the signer and check the expiry date.

notes.title: Webhook retries flood the queue
notes.body: A failing webhook endpoint made every retry land in the queue at once. Add jittered backoff to the webhook retry loop.

notes.title: Upload proxy timeout decision
notes.body: Alpha decided the upload proxy timeout stays at 30 seconds for its own tenants.

notes.title: Alpha billing rounding rules
notes.body: Alpha billing rounds invoice totals half up to the cent for every tenant.

notes.title: Alpha rotate backup keys plan
notes.body: Plan to rotate the backup encryption keys every quarter in alpha.

notes.title: Beta quarterly orchard status
notes.body: The beta orchard harvest report is green and the pruning schedule is on track.

retrieval.prompt: how do I rotate the signing certificate
why do uploads drop when the upload proxy timeout is low
the webhook retries flood the queue again
what is our cache eviction policy
add jittered backoff when a webhook endpoint keeps failing
restart the signer after you rotate the certificate

should we rotate the backup keys every quarter
is the pruning schedule on track
which proxy do we use for file downloads
